name: Gowa
description: Golang WhatsApp - Built with Go for efficient memory use
composeYaml:
services:
  gowa:
    image: 'aldinokemal2104/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice:latest'
    environment:
      - 'APP_BASIC_AUTH=${GOWA_USER}:${GOWA_PASSWORD}'
      - APP_PORT=3000
      - 'APP_DEBUG=${APP_DEBUG:-false}'
      - 'APP_ACCOUNT_VALIDATION=${APP_ACCOUNT_VALIDATION:-false}'
      - 'WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK=${WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK}'
      - 'WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET=${WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET}'
    volumes:
      - 'gowa_data:/app/storages'
